items.title: Avery "Kid" Howard Interview, 1961-05-22
items.q: The mention of 'Jeff' appears in a transcript segment labeled [SPEAKER_04], not [INTERVIEWEE]. The [INTERVIEWEE] does not mention Jeff or interact with them in the provided text.

ctx.x: Well, I don't know, most of the time I have to play like George Tate played. I mean, so that... ...

... ... ... My mama told me she said, Stop, please stand on your lawn. She ain't no good. She better take all your money and give it to a sweet man. You know something, man? I'm one of those gals on his foot down. I'm going around there and call her just one more time. Gals on you. Gals on you. When they don't think it's all right, I love you. We love you, Jeff. I said. Friends about you, babe, because Gals on your real life. Oh. Is that the Magic College of Madison Square Garden?

The Caldonia Club? No, that's... What you call it? No, it's called the Lucky Ball for a while. The two guys were dressed up like women. They got arrested. And the judge asked them why they were arrested. And they said, We don't know the name of it. We call it Little Madison Square Garden. I don't know.
